title: Polynomial-time computability of the second rest function
statement: The function that maps a bit string $w$ to the result of applying the unary rest transducer to the result of applying that transducer to the suffix of $w$ obtained by deleting its first four bits is computable by a finite Turing machine in polynomial time.
